CreatePet: the TypeScript client cannot send application/xml bodies yet
GetCard: the TypeScript client cannot read application/xml responses yet; response 200 is unexpected to it
PutCard: the TypeScript client cannot send application/xml bodies yet; the operation is left out
BatchPets: the TypeScript client cannot send multipart/mixed bodies yet; the operation is left out

PutNotes: the TypeScript client cannot send multipart/alternative bodies yet; the operation is left out
